title: Ticket prices
description:
Read an age and print the ticket it needs:

| Age | Prints |
|---|---|
| not a number, or below 0 | `Invalid age` |
| 0 to 3 | `Free entry` |
| 4 to 12 | `Child ticket: $6.50` |
| 13 to 64 | `Adult ticket: $12.00` |
| 65 and over | `Senior ticket: $8.00` |

```
Age? 9
Child ticket: $6.50
```

Read the whole line with `io.read()` and convert it with `tonumber`, so that text such as `ten` gives `Invalid age`.

starter.main.lua:
io.write("Age? ")
local age = tonumber(io.read())
print("Adult ticket: $12.00")

solution.main.lua:
io.write("Age? ")
local age = tonumber(io.read())
if not age or age < 0 then
    print("Invalid age")
elseif age <= 3 then
    print("Free entry")
elseif age <= 12 then
    print("Child ticket: $6.50")
elseif age <= 64 then
    print("Adult ticket: $12.00")
else
    print("Senior ticket: $8.00")
end

hints: `tonumber("ten")` is `nil`. Test for that first, before comparing: `nil < 0` is an error.
In an `if ... elseif` chain only the first true branch runs, so each test only needs the upper limit.
